cast.老陈: LAO CHEN: a tall, gaunt, very old ash-WHITE crane-like bird with a long thin neck, a long thin grey beak, drooping white whisker feathers and tired half-closed eyes, wearing a long OXBLOOD-red greatcoat with a high collar and a wide-brimmed black hat, a small iron rose-shaped badge on a chain round his neck, his left foot thickly wrapped in a white bandage, leaning on a thin wooden cane
